title: Block Description
description: Information about the block, must have at minimum an "identifier" and can have also the following optional field "menu_category", "states" and/or "traits"

identifier.title: Identifier
identifier.description: Must have a namespace and can't use the "minecraft" one. Example: "namespace:my_block"

menu_category.title: Menu Category
menu_category.description:
Configures the block behavior in inventory and menu category

Properties:
• category (string)
• group (string)
• is_hidden_in_commands (boolean)

defaultSnippets.label: Block Menu Category
defaultSnippets.description: Configures the block behavior in inventory and menu category

states.title: States
states.description: Define custom states for a block that can be referenced in permutation. Each state must contain an array or a "values" with an array or a "min"/"max" range

traits.title: Traits
traits.description:
Change the connection, multiblock state, placement position and/or direction behaviors of a block

Properties:
• minecraft:connection (object) = {"enabled_states":[]
• minecraft:multi_block (object) = {"direction":"up","e
• minecraft:placement_direction (object) = {"blocks_to_corner_w
• minecraft:placement_position (object) = {"enabled_states":[]

defaultSnippets.label: Block Traits
defaultSnippets.description: Change the connection, multiblock state, placement position and/or direction behaviors of a block

block_menu_category.title: Block Menu Category
block_menu_category.description: Configures the block behavior in inventory and menu category

category.title: CreativeItemCategory
category.description: The creative inventory or recipe book tab that the block is placed into. Default to "none".

group.title: Group
group.description: The expandable group that the block is a part of. Must be a namespace and can use vanilla ones

is_hidden_in_commands.title: Is Hidden In Commands
is_hidden_in_commands.description: Is the block hidden from use in commands.

block_connection.title: Block Connection
block_connection.description: Adds connection states to the block. The values of these states are updated when the block or neighboring blocks change.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which connection states to enable. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_connections"]. Must specify at least one.

block_multi_block.title: Block Multi Block
block_multi_block.description: Adds the "minecraft:multi_block_part" state and multi block functionality to the block.

direction.title: Facing
direction.description: The direction the block parts are placed starting from 'minecraft:multi_block_part' permutation '0' to permutation 'parts'. Default value is 'up'.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which state to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:multi_block_part"].

parts.title: Parts
parts.description: The number of block parts, this sets the value for state 'minecraft:multi_block_part'. Default value is '2'.

block_placement_direction.title: Block Placement Direction
block_placement_direction.description: Adds the "minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction" and/or "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction" states and setter function to the block.

blocks_to_corner_with.description:
A list of block descriptors that define the blocks to connect with the corner shape.

Properties:
• name (string) = 
• states (int) = {}
• tags (string) =

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which states to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:cardinal_direction", "minecraft:facing_direction", "minecraft:corner_and_cardinal_direction"].

y_rotation_offset.title: y Rotation Offset
y_rotation_offset.description: The y rotation offset to apply to the block. Must be [0.0, 90.0, 180.0, 270.0, 360.0]. Default is 0, meaning if the player is facing north, the "minecraft:cardinal_direction" and/or "minecraft:facing_direction" state will be north.

block_placement_position.title: Block Placement Position
block_placement_position.description: Adds the "minecraft:block_face" and/or "minecraft:vertical_half" states and setter function to the block.

enabled_states.title: Enabled States
enabled_states.description: Which states to enable. Must specify at least one. Options: ["minecraft:block_face", "minecraft:vertical_half"].
